author: blu
body: The literal's span is the opening bracket's, taken before it is consumed and threaded through both loops. Without it the desugarer had nothing to give AListExpr but synthetic-span, so a diagnostic about the literal AS A WHOLE -- CDX9004, a literal past max-list-literal-elems -- had to borrow the first element's span and point at the wrong thing.

author: blu
body: The guard cannot simply take `tok.column >= col`: a dedented arm must still end the match, and that is what `ln` advancing preserves -- it only ever moves to a line an arm was already accepted on.

author: blu
body: Alternatives expanded from one source arm share the first pattern's source offset as their alt-group, so the text emitter can re-merge exactly the arms the author wrote as an or-pattern and no others.

author: blu
body: The trigger is ordinary prose. An unterminated act block makes the statement loop swallow the chapter beneath it, and prose sentences end in a period: a dot followed by a newline, or by a capitalised word, is not followed by a field name, so it arrives here.
